findings.reason: Live resolution: no higher-numbered ADR frontmatter lists ADR-0083 in supersedes/amends/superseded_by/amended_by; no body-level supersedes/replaces/obsoletes claim found. ADR-0329 (Accepted) explicitly preserves ADR-0083 Rust error-handling tier vocabulary. Many later ADRs (0540+, 0562 cluster, fail-closed authz series) still depend_on/related ADR-0083 for thiserror/anyhow/Tier-3 no-panic — consistent with live Accepted authority. Decision aligns with north-star Rust whole-stack and fail-closed/telemetry-first posture. Note (non-mutating): some later ADRs mis-cite ADR-0083 as Cedar authz authority; that is citation noise in those files, not supersession of error-handling.
